chapter.verse: Ka thahatna ahi Topa aw, nang kong it hi.
Topa in ka suangpi, ka munkip muanhuai, hong honkhia-pa, ka Pasian, ka suangpi, ka belhpa, ka lum, ka kihotkhiatna ki, ka munkip ahi hi.
A phat taak Topa ka sam a, ka galte kiang panin ka suakta hi.
Sihna khaute in hong gakcip a, siatna tuihualte in hong nawk hi.
Leinuai sihna khaute in hong kancip a, sihna thangte in kei hong dawntuah hi.
Ka gimna-ah Topa ka sam a, ka Pasian’ tungah huhna ngenin ka kiko hi. Amah in a biakinn panin ka aw hong za a, amah ka kohna aw in a bilte va ban hi.
Ama hehna hangin leitung kipumpei in, kiveei a, mual bulpite zong lingin kising damdam hi.
Ama nakvangte panin meikhu pusuak a, a kam panin mei husia pusuak hi; ama tung panin mei-am san kuangkhia hi.
Amah in vanpi niamsak-in hong kumsuk a, ama khe nuai-ah meivom sahpi om hi.
Amah in Kherub khat tungah tuangin hong leeng a, huih khate tungah manlang takin hong leeng hi.
A kimkot-a ama ki-um nadingin khuamial bawl a, a tung kikhuh nadingin meii sahpi leh tui tawh ziingsak hi.
Ama mai-a khuavak panin gialpi leh mei-amte in ama meii sahpite phulet hi.
Topa zong vantungah awng a, Sangpen Pa in gialpi leh mei-amte ahi ama aw hong gingsak hi.
Amah in a thaltangte lawn a, amaute kithehthang sak hi; khuaphialep phiasak a, amaute susia hi.
Topa aw, nangma mawhsakna, na nakging tawh tuipi taw kimu a, leibulpite a guakin om hi.
Amah in a sang panin a khut tawh zam-in hong la a, tui thukpi panin keimah hong kaikhia hi.
Ka gal hatpa kiang pan leh hong mudahte kiang panin amah in keimah hong honkhia hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amaute kei’ adingin hat lua hi.
Amaute in ka kamsiat ni-in kei hong neh uh hangin Topa in kei hong huhpa ahi hi.
Amah in mun tanzau khatah kei hong paikhiatpih a, kei tungah lungkim ahih manin hong honkhia hi.
Topa in ka thumanna tawh kizui-in keimah noptuamna hong pia a, ka khut siangthona tawh kizui-in hong dinkik hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa ’ lampite ka tawn khin a, ka Pasian kiang panin gitlohna tawh ka paikhia kei hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ama biakna ngeina kipte khempeuh ka mai-ah om a, a thukhamte ka paikhia kei hi.
Ama mai-ah kawkbang loin, kisuan’ nadingte panin ka kikem hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Topa in ka thumanna leh ama muhna-ah ka siangthona tawh kizui-in hong dinkik khin hi.
Thuman mi tungah nangmah na thuman a, kawkbang lo mi tungah na diktat hi.
A siangtho mi tungah na siangtho gamtat a, thukawi mite na galbawl hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah in miniamte na honkhia a, ahih hangin mi kiphasakte na niamsak hi.
Hi hi, nangmah in keima mei na vaak a, Topa ka Pasian in ka khuamial na vaaksak hi.
Hi hi, nangma hangin galkap honkhat ka sugawp thei a, ka Pasian hangin khuakulh khat ka kan thei hi.
Hih Pasian a thu kicing a, Topa ’ kamciamna a manna kilang hi; amah a belte khempeuh adingin amah in kidalna lum ahi hi.
Topa longal, Pasian kua hiam? Pasian longal, suangpi kua hiam?
keimah thahatna hong guan, Pasian, ka lampi lungmuan’ nadinga a bawlpa ahi hi.
Amah in sangaipi’ khe bangin keima khe bawl a, mun sangna-ah keimah hong koih hi.
Galsim siam nadingin ka khutte hong hilh a, ka khut in sumngo thal nangawn a keek zo hi.
Na hotkhiatna lum hong pia khinin, na taklam khut in hong phong a, na huhna in kei hong liansak hi.
Ka kalsuan nading mun tanzau nong pia a, ka khe taal lo hi.
Ka galte delhin ka pha a, a vekpi-un a kisiat khit matengin ka ciahkik kei hi.
Amaute a thawhkik zawh loh nadingun ka sunlet a, ka khe nuai-ah puk uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh galdo nadingin keimah tha nong guan a, keimah hong dote ka nuai-ah na nenniam hi.
Ka galte nangmah in na nungkik sak a, kei hong mudahte ka susia hi.
Huh ding ngenin amaute kiko uh a, ahih hangin a hon ding kuamah om lo hi; amaute in Topa tungah ko uh a, ahih hangin amah in dawng lo hi.
Huihpi mai-ah leivui bangin amaute ka satvui a, kongzing buante bangin amaute ka lawnkhia hi.
Mite tawh kidona panin nangmah in kei nong honkhia a, minamte’ lutang-in kei nong bawl a, ka theih ngei loh mite in keima na hong sem uh hi.
Ka thu a zak phetun amaute in hong mang uh a, gamdang mite in kei hong mai-et uh hi.
Gamdang mite lungkia a, a phualkip panun a liing sa-in hong paikhia uh hi.
Topa hing hi; ka suangpi in thupha ngah hen la, ka kihotkhiatna Pasian,
hong thuhkik sakin ka nuai-ah mite hong zawhsak Pasian,
ka galte kiang panin keimah hong honkhiapa lian ta hen. Hi hi, ka langte tungah kei hong liansak a, mi ngongtatte kiang panin nong honkhia hi.
Topa aw, hih thu hangin minam dangte lakah nang kong phat ding a, na min phatna la ka sa ding hi.
Zawhna lianpi ama kumpipa tungah pia a, a sathau nilhpa David leh a suan a khakte tungah tawntungin itna kip a lak hi.
